about: Collect for the commemoration of Saint Petronilla. Rejoicing in her feast, we ask God to form us in a spirit of reverent devotion.

seg.tr: Hear us, God our Savior, so that, as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Petronilla, Your virgin, we may likewise be formed in a spirit of reverent devotion.

a.g: the feast of blessed Petronilla, Your virgin
we may be formed in a spirit of reverent devotion

ex.w004: God is addressed as our Savior. Salutaris is used as a title here, not as the neuter word for salvation.
ex.w009: The prayer calls Saint Petronilla blessed. This is an epithet, not a separate claim about her beatification status.
ex.w018: The prayer asks that we be formed, rather than saying that we are already formed. The rejoicing, by contrast, is stated as a present fact.
ex.w019: Affectu names an inward disposition of reverent devotion. The ablative links this disposition to the formation, with a possible nuance of manner or means.

seg.tr: Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: who lives and reigns with You

ex.w036: God describes Christ, the Son, not the Father being addressed. The Son lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
